infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NED Transport Hub uses your location to set pickup points, match nearby campus rides, share live trip location, and send emergency SOS coordinates.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NED Transport Hub uses the camera to capture driver verification documents (licence, vehicle registration, and NED ID).
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NED Transport Hub accesses your photos to upload driver verification documents.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow NED Transport Hub to use your location for ride matching, live tracking, and SOS alerts.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow NED Transport Hub to select driver verification documents from your photo library.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow NED Transport Hub to photograph driver verification documents.
